answer: One concrete mechanism: each new agent must stake a bonded deposit plus complete a unique proof-of-personhood challenge, and reputation is weighted by stake age. Sybils must fund many identities, each paying the same deposit and waiting through slow stake maturation, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Like a fable told at a summit above the ocean, the lesson is simple: make each fake voice expensive enough that flooding the network drowns the attacker first.
